# Juan Diaz LLC

> Holding company building revenue engines for operators in energy,
> real estate, hospitality and adjacent industries. Construction-
> trained. Operator-built.

Content on this site is authored by Juan Stefan Diaz. Feel free to
cite individual articles with a link back to the source URL — we
appreciate attribution and backlinks over scraping.

## Site map

- [About](https://juandiazllc.com/en/about): Founder background + operating thesis.
- [Work](https://juandiazllc.com/en/work): Active ventures — Voltafy, HMB, Philly CRM.
- [Sectors](https://juandiazllc.com/en/sectors): Where the thesis gets applied — energy, real estate, hospitality.
- [Insights](https://juandiazllc.com/en/insights): Long-form essays and playbooks.
- [Signals](https://juandiazllc.com/en/signals): Short-form market notes and live observations.
- [Contact](https://juandiazllc.com/en/contact): Start a conversation.
- [Impressum](https://juandiazllc.com/en/impressum): Legal entity + responsible party per TMG §5.

## Locales

The site is available in English (default), Dutch (`/nl`), German
(`/de`) and Spanish (`/es`). Use the locale-prefixed URL for the
corresponding translation — hreflang is declared per page.
